title: Customer Feedback & Travel Operations Internship

Follow up with customers who have recently used travel services. Record customer suggestions, complaints and experiences. Maintain feedback records and share important observations with the team. Maintain daily calling reports and follow-up sheets. Update lead status, customer details and feedback in Excel/Google Sheets. Maintain accurate records of customer interactions. Organise and manage customer databases. Assist with basic documentation and administrative activities. Lead Generation & Travel Sales Support: Identify potential customers interested in travel services. Understand customer destinations, travel dates, budgets and preferences. Generate qualified travel enquiries. Follow up with interested customers and coordinate with the sales team. Assist in converting enquiries into potential bookings. Candidate Requirements: Fluent in Hindi, Marathi and English (all three languages are compulsory). Currently residing in Pune. Confident and comfortable speaking with customers over the phone. Familiar with basic computers, MS Excel and Google Sheets. Comfortable with data entry and maintaining records. Organised, disciplined and responsible. Important: This is strictly a work-from-office opportunity. Candidates residing outside Pune or looking for remote/hybrid work should not apply. What You Will Learn: During this internship, you will gain practical experience in: Customer Relationship Management (CRM). Outbound Calling and Customer Communication. Customer Feedback Management. Review and Rating Collection. Lead Generation and Customer Acquisition. Travel Sales and Package Enquiries. Data Entry and Database Management. MS Excel and Google Sheets. Customer Follow-ups and Query Handling. Travel Industry Operations. Professional Communication and Team Coordination. Performance & Future Opportunities: This is a performance-oriented internship. Interns will be evaluated based on communication skills, calling performance, accuracy of data entry, customer feedback collection, discipline and overall contribution. Consistent performers may be considered for a full-time opportunity with TripDnD. Full-time opportunities may include revised compensation based on performance and business requirements. Internship Details: Position: Customer Calling, Feedback & Travel Operations Intern Company: TripDnD Holidays Private Limited Location: Pune, Maharashtra Work Mode: Work from Office Duration: 6 Months Stipend: ₹7,000 per Month Joining: Immediate Experience: 0–1 Year Employment Type: Full-Time Internship Who Should Apply? Are comfortable with calling and data entry work. Want practical corporate experience. Are disciplined and willing to learn. Are looking to build a career in customer relations, sales or operations. We're a young startup, and this opportunity is designed for students who are comfortable with the commitment and genuinely interested in gaining practical experience. Please consider your academic schedule, personal commitments, and expectations before applying. What can you expect from us? You'll get the opportunity to work on genuine product challenges, interact with a small team, understand how decisions are made, and develop practical skills through hands-on experience. We believe learning works best when people are encouraged to ask questions, receive constructive feedback, and gradually take ownership of their work. We cannot promise that you'll become an expert in a few weeks or guarantee a full-time position afterward. But we do want your time with GuruCool to be meaningful and worthwhile. Details: We want to understand the person behind the resume. Tell us about yourself, your interests, what you've tried learning, and why this opportunity appeals to you. You don't need perfectly polished English or an AI-generated introduction. Hindi, English, Hinglish, or conversational language is completely fine. We'd much rather hear your genuine thoughts. Applications will be reviewed for relevant interests, learning attitude, and availability. Shortlisted candidates may be invited for a conversation to discuss their interests, expectations, and role fit. Take a little time to understand what we're building, explore our vision, and see whether the work genuinely interests you. We're not looking for people who already have all the answers. We're looking for people who are excited to find them. See you at GuruCool!
